package.title: 跨区域桥接（传送/升降梯/入口/单向跳落/世界状态切换等跨包边）

record.mode: Road of Iniquity to Volcano Manor
record.note: The long mountain road reaches the Volcano Manor entrance grace.

record.mode: Temple of Eiglay portal route
record.note: After Godskin Noble, the lift/lava route and sending gate reach Audience Pathway.

record.mode: Raya Lucaria Glintstone Key gate
record.note: The Academy Glintstone Key is kept on the actual sealed academy entrance edge.

record.mode: Castle Morne outer road
record.note: Road to Castle Morne Lift at the castle entrance.

record.mode: Stormveil main gate entry
record.note: The post-Margit grace connects to Stormveil Main Gate.

record.mode: Divine Bridge waygate to Isolated Divine Tower
record.note: The waygate beside the Divine Bridge golem is a one-way plane transition to the isolated tower; it is not a walkable bridge to Caelid.

record.mode: 蕾娜魔法塔单向传送
record.note: Ranni 线解锁传送门后，单向抵达安瑟尔河主流；不生成反向步行边。

record.mode: 陨石坑下降
record.note: 击败碎星拉塔恩后星陨形成入口；未满足状态时不把诺克隆连入地表。

record.mode: 圣树单向传送
record.note: 传送到圣树树冠；不生成从树冠返回仪典镇的普通通行边。

record.mode: Academy Abductor Virgin death teleport
record.note: The Abductor Virgin's grab attack and death send the player to the hidden Volcano Manor underground entrance; this is explicitly one-way.

record.mode: Guest Hall to Godskin Noble
record.note: The Guest Hall route uses the cage elevators and upper path to reach the same Godskin Noble gate as the Prison Town approach.

record.mode: Ainsel River Well platform
record.note: Separates the surface well building from the vertical lift transition.

record.mode: Ainsel River Well ascent
record.note: Return from the underground well shaft to the eastern Liurnia surface building.

record.mode: Astel arena exit tunnel and lift
record.note: Leave the arena through the tunnel and take the lift to Moonlight Altar; the Dark Moon Ring condition remains explicit.

record.mode: Elden Throne to Forbidden Lands elevator
record.note: After Morgott and the Elden Throne rest, the eastern capital exit lift leads to the Forbidden Lands; this is a plane transition, not a walk through the missing city state.

record.mode: Forbidden Lands to East Altus bridge branch
record.note: The branch bridge toward the East Altus tower triggers the Fell Twins void encounter after Morgott; it is separate from the Rold road.

record.mode: Castle Sol branch
record.note: Branches into a separate Castle Sol legacy layer.

record.mode: Fire Giant approach
record.note: Boss gate from the named approach grace.

record.mode: Forge transition to Farum Azula
record.note: The Forge interaction is modeled as a one-way world-state transition into the Farum entry grace; it is not a walkable surface edge.

record.mode: Maliketh completion to Ashen Capital world state
record.note: Records the irreversible main-story epoch change separately from the arrival location; it does not represent a walkable route.

record.mode: Mohgwyn sending gate
record.note: One-way output from the western Snowfield portal.

record.mode: Pureblood Knight's Medal
record.note: Direct item teleport to the mausoleum entrance; no physical Snowfield path is implied.

record.mode: Touch Miquella's hand
record.note: One-way DLC world transition from the Mohgwyn cocoon; the Shadow Realm is not a surface continuation of the Lands Between.

record.mode: Stormhill to Castleward Tunnel
record.note: Castleward Tunnel is modeled as the approach node before the Margit gate.

record.mode: Stormveil back exit
record.note: North exit into Liurnia is kept behind Godrick.

record.mode: Main Academy Gate north seal to East Raya Lucaria Gate
record.note: The north seal at Main Academy Gate is modeled as a distinct route into Bellum Highway; it is not merged with the Academy Glintstone Key entrance gate.

record.mode: Eastern Liurnia Lake Shore to Study Hall Entrance
record.note: The white tower on the eastern coast is entered from the lake shore side.

record.mode: Inverted Study Hall to Liurnia Tower Bridge
record.note: The Carian Inverted Statue exposes the inverted traversal and the bridge exit; no direct lift shortcut is assumed.

record.mode: Liurnia Tower Bridge to Divine Tower
record.note: Cross the external bridge and use the Divine Tower lift; the Godskin Noble encounter is represented as risk.

record.mode: capital outskirts road
record.note: Outer Wall Phantom Tree approach.

record.mode: Sealed Tunnel internal route
record.note: Illusory walls and the hidden lift lead from the entrance grace to the Onyx Lord boss arena.

record.mode: well platform
record.note: Separates the physical entrance building from the shaft transition.

record.mode: Deep Siofra Well lift to Dragonbarrow
record.note: Use two Stonesword Keys to ride up from northern Siofra to the Caelid/Dragonbarrow Deep Siofra Well grace.

record.mode: Deep Siofra Well return lift
record.note: The activated lift is bidirectional; the return edge makes the cross-plane connection usable from either endpoint.

record.mode: Dragonbarrow Fork to Dragonbarrow Cave
record.note: Take the lower path east from Dragonbarrow Fork and descend to the cave entrance beneath the Minor Erdtree.

record.mode: Church of the Plague to Sellia Hideaway
record.note: Head northeast to the cemetery; the illusory wall behind the large gravestone reveals the hidden cave grace.

record.mode: Rotview Balcony to Gael Tunnel main entrance
record.note: The Caelid-side entrance lies south of Rotview Balcony near the soldier camp and vertical mine shaft.

record.mode: Third Church to Rear Gael Tunnel Entrance
record.note: The Limgrave rear entrance is reached via the cliffs north of the Third Church; its inner door remains locked before the boss is cleared.

record.mode: festival waygate
record.note: The castle waygate is not treated as permanently active.

record.mode: Starscourge Radahn completion
record.note: Post-boss grace and world-state anchor.

record.mode: Fort Faroth approach
record.note: Fort interior remains a separate layer.

record.mode: Road to the Manor to Main Caria Manor Gate
record.note: The glintstone-bolt road reaches the manor gate; the courtyard is kept as a separate legacy layer.

record.mode: Royal Moongazing Grounds to Three Sisters
record.note: The north exit from the post-boss grounds opens onto the Three Sisters rear grounds.

record.mode: Three Sisters to Renna's Rise waygate
record.note: The previously sealed Renna's Rise tower is opened by Ranni quest progression; the waygate itself remains one-way.

record.mode: Ravine-Veiled Village ladder route
record.note: The ladders above the village enter the Precipice mineshafts; this is not a surface teleport.

record.mode: Ruin-Strewn Precipice lift to Altus Plateau
record.note: The elevator beyond the boss arena is the alternate one-way arrival to Altus Plateau.

record.mode: Dragonbarrow West to Divine Tower Center
record.note: Roots, ledges and ladders are modeled as a high-risk parkour edge rather than a flat walk.

record.mode: Limgrave Tower Bridge sending gate
record.note: Three bridge golems guard the sending gate; the destination is the tower interior, not a walkable continuation across the broken bridge.

record.mode: Frenzied Flame hidden Deeproot route
record.note: The hidden Frenzied Flame route is a separate way into Deeproot Depths and is not conflated with the Siofra Aqueduct coffin route.

record.mode: Rampartside Path to Shaded Castle Ramparts
record.note: The northern approach enters the poisoned castle ramparts as a separate legacy layer.

record.mode: Church of Elleh to Stormfoot Catacombs
record.note: Ride northwest from the Church of Elleh through the woods to the catacomb entrance grace; the route is a branch, not a Gatefront detour.

record.mode: Limgrave Tunnels entrance elevator
record.note: The mine lift descends from the outdoor mouth to the lower entrance grace; this is a vertical plane transition.

record.mode: Church of Elleh to Groveside Cave
record.note: Head west from the Church of Elleh along the northern Limgrave road to the cave entrance grace.

record.mode: Church of Elleh to Coastal Cave
record.note: Travel west and downhill from the Church of Elleh to the beach cave; this is not the Caelid Cathedral location.

record.mode: Coastal Cave rear passage to Dragon Communion island
record.note: The rear cave passage emerges on the Dragon Communion island; it is modeled as a one-way plane exit until a reverse route is separately verified.

record.mode: Murkwater Coast to Murkwater Catacombs
record.note: Activate the cliff statue, use the spirit spring to negate the descent, then enter the catacomb grace north of Murkwater River.

record.mode: Murkwater Coast to Murkwater Cave
record.note: Follow the stream north from the lake/river approach to the cave grace; Bloody Finger Nerijus is not merged into the cave Boss node.

record.mode: Saintsbridge to Deathtouched Catacombs
record.note: Take the west path from Saintsbridge to the catacomb entrance in northern Stormhill.

record.mode: Highroad Cave entrance passage
record.note: The hidden cave mouth leads to the internal Highroad Cave grace.

record.mode: South of the Lookout Tower to Earthbore Cave
record.note: Follow the northern cliff strip toward the cave mouth between the lookout tower and demi-human forest.

record.mode: Fourth Church of Marika to Tombsward Cave
record.note: Head southeast through the western peninsula forest to the poison cave entrance.

record.mode: Church of Pilgrimage to Tombsward Catacombs
record.note: Descend to the stone arch and fallen pillar north of the peninsula Minor Erdtree to reach the catacomb grace.

record.mode: Castle Morne Rampart to Impaler's Catacombs
record.note: Ride northeast onto the plateau, follow the jellyfish/cliff landmarks and descend to the Impaler's Catacombs entrance.

record.mode: Stillwater Cave entrance passage
record.note: The cliff mouth leads to the internal Stillwater grace.

record.mode: Scenic Isle to Lakeside Crystal Cave
record.note: Head directly south from Scenic Isle to the unmarked cave in the rock wall.

record.mode: Lakeside Crystal Cave to Slumbering Wolf's Shack
record.note: The cave's rear route emerges at Slumbering Wolf's Shack after the Bloodhound Knight state.

record.mode: Converted Tower to Road's End Catacombs
record.note: Descend the western Liurnia cliff route southwest of the Minor Erdtree to the catacomb grace.

record.mode: Cliffbottom Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The lower cliff mouth leads to the internal catacomb grace.

record.mode: Academy island to Academy Crystal Cave seal
record.note: The cave seal consumes two Stonesword Keys before the physical cave entrance is available.

record.mode: Academy Crystal Cave entrance passage
record.note: The opened seal leads to the internal grace.

record.mode: Academy Crystal Cave rear belfry lift
record.note: The lift behind the Crystalian room rises to the Academy's highest belfry.

record.mode: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel entrance passage
record.note: The lake-shore mouth leads to the internal mine grace.

record.mode: Ruined Labyrinth to Black Knife Catacombs
record.note: The road northeast from Ruined Labyrinth reaches the catacomb entrance guarded by a Mausoleum Knight.

record.mode: Old Altus Tunnel entrance lift
record.note: The entrance lift descends to the internal mine grace.

record.mode: Perfumer's Grotto entrance passage
record.note: The flower-hidden mouth leads to the internal grotto grace.

record.mode: Unsightly Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The opened Imp statue route reaches the catacomb grace.

record.mode: Sage's Cave entrance passage
record.note: The pool-edge grotto leads to the internal grace.

record.mode: Auriza Hero's Grave entrance lift
record.note: The starting lift descends to the internal grace.

record.mode: Auriza Side Tomb entrance passage
record.note: The entrance passage reaches the first grace before the trapped-chest maze.

record.mode: Gelmir Hero's Grave entrance lift
record.note: The entrance elevator descends to the internal grace.

record.mode: Wyndham Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The entrance corridor reaches the catacomb grace before the lift and lightning traps.

record.mode: Seethewater Cave entrance passage
record.note: The opened Imp seal leads to the cave's internal grace.

record.mode: Volcano Cave entrance passage
record.note: The cave opening leads directly to the internal grace.

record.mode: Altus Tunnel entrance lift
record.note: The mine lift descends to the internal grace.

record.mode: Sainted Hero's Grave entrance lift
record.note: The elevator descends to the crypt grace.

record.mode: Abandoned Cave entrance passage
record.note: The cave mouth descends into the scarlet-rot cave grace.

record.mode: Caelid Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The entrance route reaches the internal grace before the rot pools.

record.mode: Gaol Cave entrance passage
record.note: The short tunnel leads to the prison cave grace.

record.mode: Gaol Cave one-way Limgrave exit
record.note: The boss-side door opens onto the Limgrave cliff near the Regalia of Eochaid route; this is not modeled as a reversible walk edge.

record.mode: Minor Erdtree Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The entrance reaches the grace before the lift and rot lower floor.

record.mode: War-Dead Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The post-battlefield entrance reaches the internal grace.

record.mode: Sellia Crystal Tunnel entrance passage
record.note: The mine mouth reaches the internal grace.

record.mode: Cave of the Forlorn entrance passage
record.note: The cave mouth leads to the internal grace.

record.mode: Snowfield Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The catacomb mouth reaches its entrance grace.

record.mode: Yelough Anix Tunnel entrance lift
record.note: The frozen mine lift descends to the internal grace.

record.mode: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave entrance lift
record.note: The Hero's Grave lift descends to the internal grace.

record.mode: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs entrance passage
record.note: The entrance stairs reach the catacomb grace.

record.mode: Spiritcaller's Cave entrance passage
record.note: The opened fog seal reaches the cave grace.

record.mode: Morne Tunnel entrance lift
record.note: Take the entrance lift to the mine grace at the bottom; the mine's Misbegotten route begins below the surface layer.

record.mode: Fort Haight upper level to Godrick Knight
record.note: Climb through the occupied fort to the blood-obsessed Godrick Knight on the upper level.

record.mode: Fort Haight tower chest bypass
record.note: A risky run, stealth route or distraction can reach the tower chest without treating the Godrick Knight as a hard gate.

record.mode: Stranded Graveyard tutorial pit descent
record.note: Drop through the hole beside the seated spirit into the optional Cave of Knowledge tutorial; this is a distinct lower layer.

record.mode: Cave of Knowledge return ledge
record.note: Return to the upper Stranded Graveyard ledge after the tutorial boss; the Strength! gesture is collected on this transition.

record.mode: Precipice of Anticipation one-way teleport
record.note: Use an Imbued Sword Key to unlock the marked Sending Gate and arrive at the isolated opening island; no reverse walk edge is implied.

record.mode: Opening death/fall cutscene to Stranded Graveyard
record.note: The intended opening escape is death to the Grafted Scion or the nearby fatal fall, followed by the transition to Stranded Graveyard.

record.mode: Post-Scion fatal drop to Stranded Graveyard
record.note: Even after defeating the opening boss, the nearby cliff/fall transition leaves the isolated starting island for Stranded Graveyard.

record.mode: Gatefront rest to Melina invitation
record.note: At an eligible grace, rest and speak with Melina after the invitation threshold is met; the event is represented separately from the target hub.

record.mode: Lake-Facing Cliffs rest to Melina invitation
record.note: Representative Liurnia-side invitation trigger; this avoids implying a physical road to the isolated hub.

record.mode: Agheel Lake South to Waypoint Ruins Cellar
record.note: Follow the northern road to the Waypoint Ruins and descend through the flower-filled ruins to the cellar grace.

record.mode: Waypoint Ruins Cellar return to Agheel Lake South
record.note: Climb out of the cellar and return south to the lake road.

record.mode: Folly on the Lake to Albinauric ravine
record.note: Move southwest through the dry Albinauric lake edge and descend into the hidden village ravine.

record.mode: Albinauric ravine return to Folly on the Lake
record.note: Climb out of the ravine to the western lake shallows.

record.mode: Grand Lift of Rold secret medallion route
record.note: Use the Haligtree Secret Medallion at the Grand Lift to enter the distinct Hidden Path dungeon; this is separate from the normal Rold lift result.

record.mode: Hidden Path to the Haligtree Snowfield exit
record.note: Traverse the secret dungeon and exit to the Consecrated Snowfield; the invisible floor and Stray Mimic Tear branch are separate internal hazards.

record.mode: Study Hall Entrance return to Eastern Liurnia Lake Shore
record.note: Leave the tower entrance and return to the eastern lake shore.

record.mode: Black Knife Catacombs return to Ruined Labyrinth
record.note: Leave the catacomb mouth and return southwest to Ruined Labyrinth.

record.mode: Stillwater Cave grace return to entrance
record.note: Return through the cave passage to the southern cliff mouth.

record.mode: Lakeside Crystal Cave return to Scenic Isle
record.note: Return from the cave approach to the Scenic Isle grace.

record.mode: Road's End Catacombs return to Converted Tower
record.note: Climb out of the catacomb entrance to the Converted Tower plateau.

record.mode: Cliffbottom Catacombs grace return to entrance
record.note: Return through the catacomb entrance passage to the lower cliff mouth.

record.mode: Academy Crystal Cave grace return to surface mouth
record.note: Return through the cave passage to the two-key surface seal.

record.mode: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel grace return to mouth
record.note: Return through the mine entrance passage to the lake-shore mouth.

record.mode: Volcano Manor entrance return to Road of Iniquity
record.note: Leave the manor's outer entrance route and return to the upper Gelmir road.

record.mode: Castle Sol Main Gate return to Whiteridge Road
record.note: Leave Castle Sol through the front gate and return to the Whiteridge Road branch.

record.mode: Castle Morne Lift return to Rampart
record.note: Ride the Castle Morne entrance lift back down to the Rampart approach.

record.mode: Castleward Tunnel return to Stormhill Shack
record.note: Return from the Castleward approach to the Stormhill road.

record.mode: Siofra Well lift return to surface
record.note: Ride the Siofra Well lift back to the surface entrance.

record.mode: Stormveil Main Gate return to Margit approach
record.note: Leave Stormveil through the entrance route and return to the Margit approach grace.

record.mode: Caria Manor Main Gate return to Road to the Manor
record.note: Leave Caria Manor through its main gate and return to the Road to the Manor grace.

record.mode: Behind Caria Manor return to Royal Moongazing Grounds
record.note: Return through the opened post-Loretta exit route to the Royal Moongazing Grounds grace.

record.mode: Dragonbarrow Cave return to Dragonbarrow Fork
record.note: Leave the cave mouth and return to Dragonbarrow Fork.

record.mode: Fort Faroth return to Dragonbarrow Fork
record.note: Leave Fort Faroth and return to the Dragonbarrow Fork road.

record.mode: Shaded Castle Ramparts return to Rampartside Path
record.note: Leave the Shaded Castle approach and return to the northern Altus path.

record.mode: Cave of the Forlorn return to surface mouth
record.note: Climb the entrance route back to the surface cave mouth.

record.mode: Snowfield Catacombs return to surface mouth
record.note: Climb out from the entrance grace to the frost catacomb mouth.

record.mode: Yelough Anix Tunnel return to surface mouth
record.note: Ride the entrance lift back to the Yelough Anix surface mouth.

record.mode: Rear Gael Tunnel return to Third Church
record.note: Leave the Limgrave-side rear entrance by the exterior cliff route; the inner tunnel door remains locked from this side.

record.mode: Divine Tower of Liurnia return to Tower Bridge
record.note: Leave the summit through the tower lift and cross back to the Liurnia Tower Bridge grace.

record.mode: Divine Tower of Limgrave return to Tower Bridge
record.note: Return from the tower interior through the same bridge and sending-gate approach; this is not a reverse of the Stormveil route.

record.mode: Abductor Virgin post-boss exit to Seethewater River
record.note: After the subterranean duo is defeated, use the opened lava-cave exit onto Mt. Gelmir's Seethewater route; the pre-boss fast-travel lock is not bypassed.

record.mode: Fort Haight tower chest return to fort entrance
record.note: Descend from the southern tower chest to the fort perimeter; the Dectus Medallion pickup does not create a one-way trap.

record.mode: Fort Haight cleared knight return to fort entrance
record.note: Leave the cleared fort interior and return to its surface entrance; Kenneth Haight's quest state is separate from the physical exit.

record.mode: Main Academy Gate to South Raya Lucaria Gate return
record.note: Leave the Academy through the same southern seal after the Glintstone Key gate has been opened.

record.mode: Redmane exit sending gate to Impassable Greatbridge
record.note: Teleport back to the Caelid-side Impassable Greatbridge grace; the reverse gate is represented by the existing impassable-to-redmane-plaza edge.

record.mode: Fort Faroth to Elder Dragon Greyoll
record.note: Leave the Fort Faroth grace and cross the short Dragonbarrow field route to Greyoll south of the fort.

record.mode: Elder Dragon Greyoll cleared return to Fort Faroth
record.note: Return to Fort Faroth after clearing the field boss; no post-boss grace is fabricated.

record.label: Academy Abductor Virgin teleport triggered
record.hint: The Abductor Virgin's grab/death transition has sent the player to Volcano Manor's underground entrance.

record.label: Abductor Virgins defeated
record.hint: The Volcano Manor subterranean duo boss has been cleared and its post-boss grace is available.

record.label: Academy Crystal Cave two Stonesword Keys available
record.hint: Two Stonesword Keys have been consumed to open the Academy Crystal Cave seal.

record.label: Academy Glintstone Key available
record.hint: The Academy gate route is kept closed until an Academy Glintstone Key is available.

record.label: Astel defeated
record.hint: The route beyond the Astel arena is only available after the boss encounter is complete.

record.label: Lakeside Crystal Cave Bloodhound Knight defeated
record.hint: The Bloodhound Knight at the end of Lakeside Crystal Cave has been cleared.

record.label: Carian Inverted Statue available
record.hint: Ranni has given the Carian Inverted Statue and it can be placed at the Study Hall pedestal.

record.label: Academy Crystal Cave Crystalians defeated
record.hint: The spear and staff Crystalian pair in Academy Crystal Cave has been cleared.

record.label: Dark Moon Ring route state
record.hint: The locked route from Astel's arena to Moonlight Altar is modeled conservatively with this Ranni quest state.

record.label: Deep Siofra Well lift unlocked
record.hint: Two Stonesword Keys have been used at the northern Siofra lift; the elevator between Below the Well and Caelid is usable.

record.label: Coastal Cave Demi-Human Chiefs defeated
record.hint: Both Demi-Human Chiefs in Coastal Cave have been cleared, opening the route toward the Dragon Communion island exit.

record.label: Divine Bridge waygate active
record.hint: The Fortified Manor elevator route has activated the waygate beside the Divine Bridge golem.

record.label: Elder Dragon Greyoll defeated
record.hint: Greyoll's field-boss return state is available after the stationary dragon outside Fort Faroth is defeated.

record.label: Erdtree burned / Farum transition active
record.hint: The Forge interaction has triggered the world-state transition into Crumbling Farum Azula.

record.label: Fire Giant defeated
record.hint: The Forge of the Giants post-boss grace is only a formal destination after the Fire Giant gate.

record.label: Precipice of Anticipation waygate unlocked
record.hint: An Imbued Sword Key has been used on the Four Belfries waygate marked Precipice of Anticipation.

record.label: Frenzied Duelist defeated
record.hint: The Gaol Cave boss gate has been cleared and the Limgrave cliff exit is open.

record.label: Godrick the Grafted defeated
record.hint: The formal back exit from Stormveil to Lake-Facing Cliffs is modeled after Godrick.

record.label: Fort Haight Godrick Knight defeated
record.hint: The blood-obsessed Godrick Knight on Fort Haight's upper level has been cleared.

record.label: 已击败神皮贵族
record.hint: 击败火山官邸神皮贵族后，Temple of Eiglay 赐福可激活。

record.label: Haligtree Secret Medallion complete
record.hint: Both halves are treated as complete before opening the Consecrated Snowfield lift route.

record.label: Magma Wyrm Makar defeated
record.hint: The Ruin-Strewn Precipice boss gate has been cleared; the post-boss lift to Altus Plateau is open.

record.label: Maliketh defeated
record.hint: The Maliketh boss gate has been cleared and the Ashen Capital transition is available.

record.label: Mohg, Lord of Blood defeated
record.hint: The Cocoon of the Empyrean post-boss grace is kept closed before Mohg is defeated.

record.label: Mohg, the Omen defeated
record.hint: The Subterranean Shunning-Grounds cathedral boss has been cleared; the Cathedral grace and Frenzied Flame descent are available.

record.label: 已击败蒙葛特
record.hint: 只有击败王座前的蒙葛特后，才能把艾尔登王座作为已激活赐福目标。

record.label: 已完成仪典镇解谜
record.hint: 点亮仪典镇四座雕像后，通往圣树树冠的传送门开放。

record.label: Pureblood Knight's Medal available
record.hint: The direct Mohgwyn teleport origin is only usable after the medal has been obtained.

record.label: 已击败碎星拉塔恩
record.hint: 拉塔恩战后，宁姆格福才出现通往诺克隆的陨石坑入口。

record.label: Radahn Festival active
record.hint: Redmane's festival waygate, plaza route and shore portal are modeled separately from the post-boss world state.

record.label: 已解锁蕾娜魔法塔传送门
record.hint: Ranni 任务推进到可以使用 Renna's Rise 传送门。

record.label: Melina Roundtable invitation trigger available
record.hint: The player has crossed the relevant world-state threshold, such as resting outside Limgrave/Weeping Peninsula or facing Margit, so Melina can offer the Roundtable invitation.

record.label: Royal Knight Loretta defeated
record.hint: The Caria Manor boss gate has been cleared; the Royal Moongazing Grounds and Three Sisters exit are open.
